_comment: Bean `kpcl`, issue #956. Two entries, and BOTH belong to other streams — recorded rather than repaired because CLOSING A BEAN IS ITS OWNER'S ACT ON EVIDENCE, which means re-deriving what it claims rather than trusting its notes. `z4mq` hangs from `zzmr` (stream 1's KG epic) and `10uc` IS stream 2's own claim bean, whose stream is still running: a claim bean with every box ticked while the stream works is a question for that stream, not a defect this one may close. Same reason `bean-parents-baseline.json` records `d308` instead of re-parenting somebody's epic. `iumj` was the third and was CLOSED rather than baselined, because it is under `1swy` — this stream's own epic — and its evidence re-derived on 2026-09-24: the guard it produced runs here, 44 tests green. The file's first entry (`5a3l`, `completed` over 12 open children) was cleared on 2026-09-22 when the owner re-opened it (#970) and the entry stopped matching — this check FAILED on the stale entry, which is the property working rather than a regression. THIS FILE MAY ONLY SHRINK: an entry nothing matches is reported stale and fails, so a repair cannot leave a licence behind. An empty `outstanding` is the success state: it exempts nothing, so any new contradiction fails.
_shape: Same as bean-parents-baseline.json. Key is `<rule>:<bean-id>` — stable across a title edit, because a title is prose and an id is not.
